Temporal focus:
    T1. Historical report [YES] — recaps prior session moves in yields, FX, equities
    T2. Forward-looking reporting short-term risks (next few weeks/months) [YES] — Fed rate hike odds, NFP Friday, CPI Sept 11, Waller speech
    T3. Forward-looking reporting long-term risks (next quarters/years) [YES] — Broadcom AI chip demand outlook 2 years, BOJ policy trajectory

Synopsis:
    Bond markets stabilized modestly after recent volatility, with US and Japanese yields pulling back slightly. Oil above $90 amid US-Iran escalation is stoking inflation fears. Fed rate hike probability for the month has surged to 67%. Key near-term catalysts are Friday's NFP print and CPI on Sept 11. BOJ policy remains in focus as Japan's services sector outperforms and the yen strengthens. JGB 30-year auction provided relief after benchmark 10Y yields hit a 30-year high. Equity futures pointed to marginal gains in both Europe and the US. Broadcom flagged strong AI chip demand but still sold off after hours.

Q01. Is the content relevant to US economy, US yields, US interest rates and US stock market pricing?
Relevance: YES — Fed rate hike odds, NFP, CPI, US Treasury yields, S&P 500 futures, and Broadcom equity reaction are all directly addressed.

Q02. Is the content confirming already known information or reporting very new/uncertain risks?
Risk score: 45 — The Fed tightening narrative and oil-inflation linkage are well-established themes. However, the sharp surge in Fed hike probability (37% → 67% in one week), US-Iran strike escalation, and JGB 10Y yields hitting a 30-year high introduce meaningful fresh uncertainty.

Q03. Is the content explicitly about bullish impact on the US stock markets?
Explicit: NO — Futures are slightly green (+0.07% on S&P e-minis) but no bullish thesis is explicitly argued.
Impact score: 8 — Marginal positive futures tone, but no substantive bullish driver is presented.

Q04. Is the content explicitly about bearish impact on the US stock markets?
Explicit: NO — Bearish risks are present (oil, rate hike odds, JGB volatility, AVGO after-hours drop) but are framed as macro context, not a direct bearish call on US equities.
Impact score: 38 — Accumulation of inflationary pressures, rising rate hike probability, and geopolitical risk (US-Iran) collectively represent a meaningful, if not extreme, headwind for US equity valuations.
